content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad provide convenient platforms for processing payments and managing digital goods, but they come with serious limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, meaning the vast majority of the world is left unsupported. PayPal users face the risk of account suspensions that can freeze funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Alternatives like Lemon Squeezy and Paddle also have their own geographical restrictions, leaving creators in excluded regions scrambling without viable options. In stark contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH empowers creators with the tools they need to launch their digital storefronts, independent of geographic limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The restrictions imposed by platforms such as Stripe and PayPal often stem from regulatory compliance concerns and risk management strategies. Countries that are perceived to have higher risks of fraud or financial instability are typically excluded, resulting in a loss of opportunities for creators in those regions. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure operates independently of these restrictions, allowing users from any country to set up their digital stores without facing arbitrary barriers. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare and Supabase, creators can build a resilient, localized payment processing framework that bypasses the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms often impose high transaction fees, which can erode creators' profits. Stripe and PayPal charge a percentage of each sale plus additional fees, which can accumulate quickly. Moreover, payment processing can take several days, delaying the delivery of funds to creators. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions like NOWPayments charge a mere 0.5% fee with almost instantaneous payment confirmation via cryptocurrencies. This means creators keep more of their earnings and can deliver products immediately upon payment, improving the customer experience and enhancing sales potential.
Sovereign commerce architecture means no dependency on restrictive platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most critical aspects of using traditional platforms is the lack of true ownership over your digital assets. Once a creator uploads their products to a platform like Gumroad or Stripe, they are subject to the platform's terms and conditions, which can change at any time. With COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators maintain complete ownership of their products and customer data after deployment. The entire process is automated — from payment processing to product delivery — allowing creators to focus on their work rather than navigating platform restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right infrastructure depends on your specific needs and the complexity of your offerings. For those starting out with a limited number of products, COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack provides a quick setup at an affordable price. However, for creators looking for a more robust solution that supports multiple products and advanced features, the Edge Commerce Stack is the better option. It comes equipped with tools like Cloudflare Pages and Workers to ensure high performance and reliability, making it ideal for creators aiming to scale their digital business without the constraints of traditional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Keep 100% of your earnings with minimal transaction fees.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
